entries.title: Día de los Muertos Kids' Grab & Go: Mask Craft Kits (Limited Supply!)
entries.description: Stop by to pick up a free Day of the Dead Paper Mask Craft Kit, filled with colorful craft pieces and supplies for children to decorate their own Calavera (sugar skull) mask.\nFirst come, first served.

entries.title: LEGO CLUB
entries.description: Kids 5 years and older, apply your building skills and imaginations to have fun with LEGOs!

entries.title: Tutoring Kidz
entries.description: Through engaging games, creative activities, and interactive lessons, they help students strengthen their English and math skills while building confidence and discovering the joy of learning.

entries.title: Family Storytime + Stay & Play
entries.description: Storytime is designed to accommodate a mix of ages and invites the entire family to participate in early literacy activities such as stories, songs, rhymes, fingerplays, and movement activities.

entries.title: Baby Lap-Sit Story Time
entries.description: This program is geared for pre-walking children and their parents ornbsp;caregivers.\nBaby Lap-Sit Storytime invites newborns, infants, and their caregivers to learn together by strengthening their relationship with each other through stories, songs, bounces, tickles, rhymes, books, and play.

entries.title: Reading to Children
entries.description: Participating in the Reading to Childrennbsp;program is a great way for children to develop their imagination and spark a love for books, reading and learning.nbsp;\nChildren will enjoy a small group interaction with our volunteer and it will be held under the Read to Children sign, within the Children's Area.\nFree.

entries.title: CHCP in San Jose's Veterans Day Parade
entries.description: CHCP will be marching with History San Jose in the Veterans Day Parade, as part of the celebration of America’s 250th anniversary.

entries.title: Free Shopping Spree: Clothing Giveaway // Compras gratis: Ropa de regalo
entries.description: Browse a collection of gently used clothing (sizes from XS-XL) and take home whatever you need or love!

entries.title: LEGO SPIKE Robots!
entries.description: nbsp; Participants will follow simple step-by-stepnbsp;picture instructions on a tablet to build an exciting frog, dog, or other kind of robot, and then learn to usenbsp;simple Word Blocks to make their robot perform their commands!

entries.title: Teen Movie: Twilight
entries.description: Teens are invited to watch Twilight and enjoy some free snacks.

entries.title: Drop-in Teens Reach Volunteering
entries.description: nbsp;\nTeens of all ages are welcome to join our Drop-In Volunteer Hour every second Friday afternoon from 4PM-5PM to help with a variety of library tasks, such as creating and building book displays, tidying up spaces, decorating for holidays, maintaining craft materials and supplies, etc.

entries.title: Friday Fun - Paper Collage Owl
entries.description: Celebrate the Fall season by making your own owl friend!

entries.title: Friday Fun : Legos® Fun
entries.description: Activities may include arts crafts, special performances or workshops, and board or video games.\nNote: 2nd Friday of every month is free play withnbsp;Legos®!

entries.title: Illuminated Crafts: Cloud Chandelier
entries.description: Discover how fluffy clouds create rain, lightning, and thunder, then build your own glowing cloud chandelier that brings the magic of the sky indoors!

entries.title: Jewelry Making: STEM Craft
entries.description:
Join us for a creative jewelry making craft workshop.
Learn how to design and create your own unique bracelet using 
colorful beads and charms, andnbsp;take home your very own beaded 
bracelet.nbsp;Materials will be provided.nbsp;
Recommended for ages 7 and up.

entries.title: Make Your Own Pop Art
entries.description: Transforming ordinary objects, such as figurines and erasers, allows participants to find artistic and scientific beauty in the world around them.\nRecommended for ages 8 and up.

entries.title: Mini Canvas Painting for Teens
entries.description: Get to know other teens in your community and let your creative juices flow as you paint your own mini canvas.\nThis program is for teens ages 13-18.

entries.title: Stories & Songs in Persian !
entries.description: Children andnbsp;Families will enjoy stories and music that encourages plays and exploration, all in Persian language.

entries.title: Almaden Teens Reach Meeting
entries.description: Join ournbsp;teen service group andnbsp;earn community service credit, supporting the community by assisting with book displays, presenting children's programs, running book sales and more.

entries.title: Explore Human Anatomy with AnatoKidz
entries.description: Learn about the brain, heart, lungs, bones, and more while building curiosity, confidence, and critical thinking skills.\nThis free, two-part series is recommended for children ages 5 to 10.

entries.title: Sounds of South Asia: an exhibit
entries.description: This interactive photographynbsp;exhibit showcases several musical instruments from the South Asian subcontinent.nbsp; Each exhibit will have a QR code that allows participants to listen to the sound of the instrumentsnbsp;performed innbsp;Afghanistan, Bangladesh, Bhutan, India, Maldives, Nepal, Pakistan, and Sri Lanka.

entries.title: Code to the Moon by AACI YTI
entries.description: In this workshop, students create their own "Animated Rocket Launch" project in Scratch, using "broadcast" to create a countdown, ignition, and liftoff sequence that directs their rocket into space.

entries.title: Friends of Joyce Ellington Branch Library Book Sale
entries.description: Come support your local library branch and find new literary treasures for yourself.

entries.title: West Valley Friends of the Library Book Sale
entries.description: Come support your local library branch and find new literary treasures for yourself.\nPLEASE BRING YOUR OWN BAGS.\nONLY CASH AND CHECKS ARE ACCEPTED.SATURDAY, NOV.

entries.title: Master Gardeners: The Thrifty Table: Creating Beautiful Holiday Centerpieces
entries.description: You’ll Learn: \nThe Art of the “Found” Object: Learn how to scout your own backyard or junk drawer for unique textures, greenery, and accents that add character to any arrangement.Grocery Store Glam: Discover how to deconstruct those affordable supermarket flower bunches and reimagine them into high-end-looking centerpieces.

entries.title: Reading to Furry Friends
entries.description: \nChildren are invited to practice reading to gentle, trained assistance dogs who love books!

entries.title: Storytime with AAC
entries.description: Enhance your child's communication with "Storytime with AAC"!

entries.title: Filipino American History Month Storytime and Parol Lantern Making
entries.description: Join us for a captivating journey celebrating Filipino American History Month during our special bilingualnbsp;storytime and Parol lantern-making craft at the library.nbsp;\nDelve into the rich tapestry of Filipino culture through engaging stories, vibrant music, and exciting activities that honor the traditions and contributions of Filipino Americans.

entries.title: Puppets and Stories with Ms. Andrea
entries.description: Children will have fun listening to stories while they develop a love for books and reading.

entries.title: Village Square Chess Club
entries.description: If so, you are invited at the Village Square Branch Library to come and learn to play chess at the beginners and intermediate levels.

entries.title: Terrarium Workshop for Teens and Adults
entries.description: For our teen and adultnbsp;audience, building aquariums is a fun way to engage with others and build a sense of community for your library's community.

entries.title: STEM Saturday: Pearl Avenue Chess Club
entries.description: \nIn this program, kids will learn the basics of chess, practice clever strategies, solve fun puzzles, and challenge new friends to friendly matches. \nAll skill levels are welcome—from beginners to experienced young players!

entries.title: Music & Movement
entries.description: Build early literacy skills through movement, songs, and dance.nbsp;This week, we'll be celebrating Native American Heritage Month.\nInstruments, songs, and dance moves will all be introduced so that everyone will be able to enjoy moving along to the music.\nThis program is meant for families with children and no previous experience is needed!
entries.priorDescriptionZh: 通过动作、歌曲和舞蹈培养早期读写能力。活动会介绍乐器、歌曲和舞步，让每个人都能随着音乐一起动起来。面向有孩子的家庭，无需任何经验。

entries.title: Family Craft: Bean and Lentil Mosaics
entries.description: All materials will be provided.Family Craft events are designed for children and their adult companions to enjoy together.
entries.priorTitleZh: 家庭手工：豆类与扁豆马赛克
entries.priorDescriptionZh: 孩子和成年家人一起参与手工活动，用豆子与扁豆制作马赛克图案。

entries.title: Intermediate Mass Black Holes; Meteor Showers or Space Debris?
entries.description: In this talk, we explore how changes in visible gas emission lines over nearly two decades cannbsp;reveal these hidden engines, highlighting recent Magellan Spectrograph observations of dwarf galaxy J1143 that point to an accretingnbsp;intermediate-mass black hole at its core.
entries.priorTitleZh: 中等质量黑洞；流星雨还是太空碎片？
entries.priorDescriptionZh: 本次讲座将探讨近二十年来可见气体发射线的变化如何揭示隐藏的能量来源，并介绍 Magellan 光谱仪对矮星系 J1143 的最新观测；相关结果表明其核心可能存在一个正在吸积的中等质量黑洞。

entries.title: The Rhinoceros Project Sewing Circles
entries.description: Join The Rhinoceros Project with artists Michelle Wilson andnbsp;Anne Beck for community sewing circles where participantsnbsp;help create embroidered maps connecting Palo Alto tonbsp;historic routes across California and Mexico.The ArtLift Grant Program supports temporary projects bynbsp;local artists and creatives, fostering connection, joy, andnbsp;community engagement.Workshop
entries.priorDescriptionZh: 与艺术家 Michelle Wilson 和 Anne Beck 一起刺绣地图，连接 Palo Alto 与加州及墨西哥的历史路线。

entries.title: Soul 4Kidz Performance at Community Hall
entries.description: nbsp;This amazing groupnbsp;performs classic children's songs and family favorites with a lively, soulful twist!
entries.priorDescriptionZh: 这个精彩团体将以充满活力和灵魂乐风格的方式演绎经典儿童歌曲及全家喜爱的曲目。

entries.title: Concert: Palo Alto School of Chamber Music
entries.description: Read more about Palo Alto School of Chamber Music on theirnbsp;website.\nRegistration is not required but you will receive a reminder email the day before.
entries.priorTitleZh: 音乐会：Palo Alto 室内乐学校
entries.priorDescriptionZh: 欣赏 Palo Alto 室内乐学校带来的音乐会，可在学校官网了解更多。

entries.title: Learn About the Muwekma Ohlone Tribe
entries.description: There will be a storytime featuring the Muwekma creation storynbsp;Kàanak Hašepeknenbsp;Muwekma: I Made The People, By Me, Coyotenbsp;by Bernadette Quiroz, followed bynbsp;a craft.nbsp;This program is for children innbsp;grades 2 to 8 as well as their families. \nRegistration is required.
entries.priorTitleZh: 了解 Muwekma Ohlone 部落
entries.priorDescriptionZh: 聆听 Bernadette Quiroz 创作的 Muwekma 起源故事《Kàanak Hašepekne Muwekma: I Made The People, By Me, Coyote》，随后参加手工活动。

entries.title: Festival of Lights: A Diwali Celebration
entries.description: Rangoli (chalk coloring craft outside in the Courtyard)Crafts (in Adobe Room)All activities available while supplies last!
entries.priorDescriptionZh: 欣赏 Noorani Dance 的传统卡塔克舞艺术。舞团由国际舞者 Farah Yasmeen Shaikh 于 2016 年创立，其艺术风格融合导师 Pandit Chitresh Das 的古典与创新影响。
